description.value: Wings West Kelowna is part of the WINGS restaurant chain, a BC franchise known for award-winning chicken wings in 28 globally-inspired flavours. This 'food primary, all ages welcome' location offers a full sit-down menu including wings, burgers, salads, and pastas alongside weekly dine-in specials. Cyclists in the West Kelowna area will find a casual, family-friendly stop with online ordering available.

address.value: 1-2484 Main Street, West Kelowna, BC V4T 2G2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The dedicated West Kelowna location page confirms the business is open with a matching address (#1–2484 Main St, V4T 2G2) and phone (778) 754-0052, and the 'ORDER ONLINE' link in the header confirms takeout availability. The menu page explicitly lists 'CAULI' WINGERZ' (cauliflower-based, vegetarian) and 'GLUTEN-SMART' wings as dietary options. No information about bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content, leaving all required WWC criteria unverifiable.
